title: Database Systems Fundamentals
description: This course is designed for beginners who want to learn the basics of database systems. Students will learn how to design, create, and manage databases using SQL. By the end of the course, students will be able to create and interact with databases.

modules.title: Introduction to Databases
modules.summary: Learn the basics of databases and what they are used for.

modules.title: Database Setup and Basics
modules.summary: Install and set up a database system, and learn the basics of SQL.

modules.title: Creating and Managing Tables
modules.summary: Learn how to create and manage tables in a database.

modules.title: Querying and Updating Data
modules.summary: Learn how to query and update data in a database.

modules.title: Company Database
modules.summary: Create a company database and learn how to interact with it.

modules.title: Advanced Querying and Data Management
modules.summary: Learn advanced querying and data management techniques.

modules.title: Data Integrity and Security
modules.summary: Learn how to ensure data integrity and security in a database.

modules.title: Database Design
modules.summary: Learn how to design a database using ER diagrams.
